analysis: Descriptive audit of the current candidate extractor on local prepared XJTU charge MAT data.

mathematical_validation_summary.interpretation: Synthetic arithmetic checks validate the implemented candidate operations only; the entropy originals, source formulas, and authoritative segment definitions remain unverified.

confirmed_implementation_correction.defect: CC interval construction computed interpolated threshold crossings but clamped starts to the first selected sample and ends to the last selected sample, potentially shortening or discarding positive-duration intervals.
confirmed_implementation_correction.correction: Use the latest applicable interpolated crossing for entry and the earliest applicable interpolated crossing for exit.

frontend_build.result: passed with a non-blocking Vite large-chunk warning

target_for_descriptive_associations.interpretation: Measured capacity label used as an aging/SOH proxy only; the inspected local loader does not explicitly declare its unit or normalization lineage.

visualization_note: No feature-versus-SOH plot was generated because the available field is an unnormalized capacity label with unresolved unit/lineage; descriptive correlations are reported against that field explicitly as a proxy instead.

leakage_audit.capacity_integral_note: Charge integrals use measured current and elapsed time and may be physically associated with capacity; this is not direct reuse of the capacity_label field.

batch_cohort_note: Differences in feature distributions across batch labels are descriptive. They cannot be attributed to charging protocol alone because batch, cell composition, and other factors may be confounded.
